As the theory is still in its infancy, a mature suite of tools has not been created. 
Additionally, since each statistical problem requires specification of its own likelihood (perhaps complicated with spatial/temporal/censored/etc data), bespoke solutions have not been created for all of these.

The primary class of problems which we are proud to present a package on, is the extention to GLMs.
